taylor: quick async — prepping capacity for tomorrow's EU spike. Requesting eu-west1 quota bump (GPUs + persistent disks). current headroom ~18% on p1. can we prewarm 3 extra nodes in prod for 2h starting 04:30 UTC? link to runbook: https://go/runbooks/eu-prewarm :mag_right:
vikram: +1 for prewarm. quota request still WIP with cloud support (ticket #3421). if quota hangs, can we use spot fallback, or do we need to shift to dedicated pool?
liz: spot fallback OK but please add a canary drain window. if we prewarm, run a canary at 05:00 UTC to validate KV cache priming and model warm state.
infra-bot: Job created -> prewarm-eu-west1-8176543210 scheduled 2026-04-10T04:30:00Z. monitor /alerts/prewarm for failures.
taylor: here's the quick prewarm command (ops-friendly):
```
./provision --region eu-west1 --gpu-type a100 --count 3 --ttl 2h --tags prewarm/eu-tilt
```
vikram: filing autoscaler tweak PR now — pinging @liz for review: PR #4672. also adding fallback playbook reference.
liz: will review PR first thing. blocker note: need rollback play if canary fails (drain -> spin down -> re-route). I'll add steps to the playbook.
taylor: current blocker: cloud quota approval or ops confirmation for spot fallback. if quota denied, fallback plan is to use dedicated pool in ams2 (slightly higher latency). tagging infra-oncall to confirm.
ops-standup: oncall here — will confirm spot fallback viability by 03:45 UTC and post final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
